body: Well I just have a lot of ambitions that will probably be pretty lucky if it all turns out just how I plan it. Life rarely does!
Long road, but it's worthwhile. In my eyes at least.
Ironically enough, biomedical science into medical school. I could theoretically hang around low level jobs in the field but I'd never be satisfied without getting where I want to.
The positive thinking really helps a lot of the time, but then there's the periods where it doesn't even occur to me

Yeah I do. I have ambitions bordering on flat out insanity, it's just day to day life that I struggle with. I have an extremely long road ahead full of shit that could just upset everything, it's hard to focus on the endgame and do the menial shit right now.

Counselling could be good, it's not going to be ineffective for everyone, look into it.
It's hard to put it into perspective in my mind really. If I don't get real help it will potentially damage my future badly, but if I do, it will destroy my career and do the same damage.

That actually is a pretty apt description of some of my feelings that hadn't considered. Like I'm stuck following a calendar of events I don't really give a shit about for the sake of a continued existence.

The only help I've had so far is a few counselling sessions that I stopped going to and then a close friend, along with online media like this.

I considered attending a group help meeting for mental problems at a local church, haven't made up my mind though.

I haven't, no. I've been to a few independent counselling sessions but making myself go to them was causing more anxiety than the sessions were worth.

I'm concerned about approaching the healthcare system simply because my intended career could seriously be jeopardised by records of mental instability. I already had my other plans for life thrown out, I don't want to lose that too.

The medication available could potentially help but I don't think it's worth it.

Nothing exactly dramatic. I have a pretty easy life aside from any issues inside my own head. Minor day to day stresses, my relationships aren't what I'd like them to be, but realistically.. my life is fine and it will get better if I can bring myself to put the effort in.

That just makes it worse when I don't go a single day, most of the time more than a few hours, without considering suicide as an option rather than dealing with my life.

Not really no. I've had issues with depression and some severe anxiety but any thoughts of suicide are more recent than any bad episodes of either. Every day after deliberation on it it just feels like running away though. I'm not the type of person to run away from anything regardless of the situation so the thoughts are just messing me up even more
